title: RTP Player: Added additional shortcuts
description:
Added shortcuts:
- Mute/Unmute/Invert Mute
- Play/Pause/Stop

Removed outdated help in tooltip text. It makes no sense to use it, all
actions are available in context menu.

notes.body: I see failed build https://gitlab.com/j.novak/wireshark/-/pipelines/268759767, but failed steps has no relation to code/changes. It looks like issues in build scripts.
